concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Actual concept pixels inspected: thick jagged host, deep open-front dark cavity, inward pointed crystals and clear central void adopted. Crystal habit explicit scalenohedron:12 triangular faces, alternating high/low equatorial vertices and unequal axial tips, no hexagonal prismatic shafts. Vary lengths, orientations and sizes in several tiers, taper toward inward cavity volume. Most crystals line wall, a few longer focal crystals, keep central void visible; rear mostly limestone. No copied image silhouette or specimen assay.
